cards.definition: A running program: its address space, registers (incl. PC and stack pointer) and open files.
cards.example: Two browser tabs may run as two processes.

zh-Hans.definition: 正在运行的程序：包括地址空间、寄存器（含程序计数器和栈指针）和打开的文件。

cards.definition: Running, ready, or blocked; the OS moves processes between them.
cards.example: A process waiting on disk I/O is blocked.

zh-Hans.definition: 运行、就绪或阻塞；操作系统在这些状态间切换进程。

cards.definition: Kernel structure storing a process’s state, saved registers and metadata.
cards.example: Context switch saves registers into the PCB.

zh-Hans.definition: 保存进程状态、寄存器及元数据的内核结构。

cards.definition: System call that creates a child process as a near-copy of the caller.
cards.example: fork() returns 0 in the child and the child’s PID in the parent.

zh-Hans.definition: 创建子进程的系统调用，子进程几乎是调用者的副本。

cards.definition: Replaces the current process image with a new program.
cards.example: The shell forks, then the child execs ls.

zh-Hans.definition: 用新程序替换当前进程映像。

cards.definition: Parent blocks until a child process finishes.
cards.example: The shell waits for the command to exit before printing the prompt.

zh-Hans.definition: 父进程阻塞直到子进程结束。

cards.definition: Controlled entry from user code into the kernel to request a privileged service.
cards.example: open(), read() and write() are system calls.

zh-Hans.definition: 用户代码受控进入内核以请求特权服务的入口。

cards.definition: Instruction that switches to kernel mode and jumps to a handler from the trap table.
cards.example: A system call executes a trap; return-from-trap resumes the user program.

zh-Hans.definition: 切换到内核态并跳转至陷阱表中处理程序的指令。

cards.definition: Processor privilege levels: user code is restricted, the kernel may do anything.
cards.example: Executing I/O instructions in user mode raises an exception.

zh-Hans.definition: 处理器特权级别：用户代码受限，内核可执行任何操作。

cards.definition: Run programs directly on the CPU for speed, but keep control via traps and timer interrupts.
cards.example: The OS sets up the trap table at boot, then lets programs run.

zh-Hans.definition: 让程序直接在 CPU 上运行以求速度，并通过陷阱和定时器中断保持控制。

cards.definition: Periodic hardware interrupt that hands control back to the OS so it can reschedule.
cards.example: Every 10 ms the timer fires and the scheduler runs.

zh-Hans.definition: 周期性硬件中断，使控制权回到操作系统以便重新调度。

cards.definition: Saving one process’s registers and restoring another’s so the CPU runs a different process.
cards.example: Switching from editor to compiler on the same core.

zh-Hans.definition: 保存一个进程的寄存器并恢复另一个进程的寄存器，使 CPU 运行不同进程。

cards.definition: Completion time minus arrival time of a job.
cards.example: Arrives at 0, finishes at 30 → turnaround 30.

zh-Hans.definition: 作业完成时间减去到达时间。

cards.definition: Time from arrival until the job first runs.
cards.example: Arrives at 0, first scheduled at 10 → response 10.

zh-Hans.definition: 从作业到达到首次运行的时间。

cards.definition: Run jobs in arrival order to completion; suffers from the convoy effect.
cards.example: A 100-s job ahead of three 10-s jobs.

zh-Hans.definition: 按到达顺序运行作业直至完成；存在护航效应。

cards.definition: Run the shortest job first; optimal average turnaround if all arrive together.
cards.example: Run the 10-s jobs before the 100-s job.

zh-Hans.definition: 先运行最短作业；所有作业同时到达时平均周转时间最优。

cards.definition: Preemptive SJF: always run the job with the least remaining time.
cards.example: A new 5-s job preempts a job with 50 s left.

zh-Hans.definition: 抢占式 SJF：总是运行剩余时间最少的作业。

cards.definition: Run each job for a time slice, then switch; good response time, poor turnaround.
cards.example: 10-ms slices rotating through A, B, C.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个作业运行一个时间片后切换；响应时间好，周转时间差。

cards.definition: Short jobs stuck behind a long one, inflating average turnaround.
cards.example: Three quick tasks wait behind a long batch job.

zh-Hans.definition: 短作业被困在长作业之后，拉高平均周转时间。

cards.definition: Several priority queues; jobs that use full slices move down, interactive ones stay high; periodic boost avoids starvation.
cards.example: An editor stays high priority, a long compile sinks.

zh-Hans.definition: 多个优先级队列；用满时间片的作业降级，交互式作业保持高优先级；周期性提升防止饥饿。

cards.definition: Periodically move all jobs to the top queue so long jobs are not starved.
cards.example: Every second, every job returns to queue 0.

zh-Hans.definition: 定期把所有作业移至最高队列，避免长作业饥饿。

cards.definition: A job never gets to run because others always take priority.
cards.example: Too many interactive jobs starve a batch job.

zh-Hans.definition: 作业因其他作业始终优先而永远得不到运行。

cards.definition: Proportional share: each job holds tickets; a random draw picks who runs each slice.
cards.example: A has 75 tickets, B 25 → A runs ~75% of the time.

zh-Hans.definition: 比例份额调度：每个作业持有彩票，每个时间片随机抽签决定谁运行。

cards.definition: Deterministic proportional share: run the job with the lowest pass, then add its stride.
cards.example: Stride = 10,000 / tickets.

zh-Hans.definition: 确定性比例份额：运行通行值最小的作业，再加上其步长。

cards.definition: Linux scheduler that runs the process with the lowest virtual runtime, weighted by niceness.
cards.example: A red-black tree orders processes by vruntime.

zh-Hans.definition: Linux 调度器，按 nice 值加权，运行虚拟运行时间最少的进程。

cards.definition: Keeping a process on the same CPU so its cached data stays warm.
cards.example: Migrating a thread to another core loses its L1/L2 contents.

zh-Hans.definition: 让进程留在同一 CPU 上，以保持其缓存数据有效。

cards.definition: The process’s private view of memory: code, heap and stack.
cards.example: Every process sees its own address 0.

zh-Hans.definition: 进程私有的内存视图：代码、堆和栈。

cards.definition: OS illusion that each process has a large private memory, mapped onto physical RAM (and disk).
cards.example: Two processes both use virtual address 0x4000 for different data.

zh-Hans.definition: 操作系统营造的每个进程拥有大块私有内存的假象，映射到物理内存（及磁盘）。

cards.definition: Hardware converts each virtual address into a physical address on every access.
cards.example: Virtual 1 KB → physical 33 KB.

zh-Hans.definition: 硬件在每次访问时将虚拟地址转换为物理地址。

cards.definition: Relocation with two registers: physical = virtual + base, checked against bounds.
cards.example: Base 32 KB, bounds 16 KB.

zh-Hans.definition: 用两个寄存器重定位：物理地址 = 虚拟地址 + 基址，并检查界限。

cards.definition: CPU hardware that performs address translation and protection checks.
cards.example: The MMU raises a fault on an out-of-bounds access.

zh-Hans.definition: 执行地址转换和保护检查的 CPU 硬件。

cards.definition: Separate base/bounds per logical segment (code, heap, stack) so sparse address spaces fit.
cards.example: Stack segment grows downward with its own base.

zh-Hans.definition: 为每个逻辑段（代码、堆、栈）设置独立的基址/界限，使稀疏地址空间得以容纳。

cards.definition: Free memory split into small holes that cannot satisfy a larger request.
cards.example: 20 KB free in 1 KB pieces cannot fit a 4 KB segment.

zh-Hans.definition: 空闲内存被分割成小块，无法满足较大的请求。

cards.definition: Wasted space inside an allocated block that is bigger than requested.
cards.example: Asking for 5 KB and getting an 8 KB block.

zh-Hans.definition: 分配块大于所需，块内空间被浪费。

cards.definition: Allocator’s list of available memory chunks, with splitting and coalescing.
cards.example: free() merges adjacent chunks back into one.

zh-Hans.definition: 分配器记录可用内存块的列表，支持分割与合并。

cards.definition: Splits memory in powers of two; freed blocks merge with their “buddy”.
cards.example: A 64 KB block splits into two 32 KB buddies.

zh-Hans.definition: 按 2 的幂分割内存；释放的块与其“伙伴”合并。

cards.definition: Divide virtual memory into fixed-size pages mapped to physical frames; no external fragmentation.
cards.example: 4 KB pages mapped anywhere in RAM.

zh-Hans.definition: 将虚拟内存划分为固定大小的页并映射到物理帧；无外部碎片。

cards.definition: Per-process structure mapping virtual page numbers to physical frame numbers.
cards.example: VPN 3 → PFN 7.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个进程将虚拟页号映射到物理帧号的结构。

cards.definition: One mapping in the page table: PFN plus valid, protection, present, dirty and reference bits.
cards.example: Valid=1, PFN=7, R/W.

zh-Hans.definition: 页表中的一条映射：物理帧号及有效、保护、存在、脏、访问等标志位。

cards.definition: A virtual address splits into virtual page number (translated) and offset (kept).
cards.example: 4 KB pages: top bits = VPN, low 12 bits = offset.

zh-Hans.definition: 虚拟地址分为需转换的虚拟页号和保持不变的页内偏移。

cards.definition: Translation lookaside buffer: small hardware cache of recent virtual-to-physical translations.
cards.example: A TLB hit avoids walking the page table.

zh-Hans.definition: 转换后备缓冲器：缓存最近虚拟到物理地址转换的小型硬件缓存。

cards.definition: Translation not in the TLB; hardware or OS walks the page table and inserts it.
cards.example: First touch of an array page misses, the rest hit.

zh-Hans.definition: TLB 中没有该转换；由硬件或操作系统查页表并填入。

cards.definition: Address-space identifier tagging TLB entries so they survive context switches.
cards.example: TLB keeps entries for process 1 and 2 side by side.

zh-Hans.definition: 标记 TLB 项所属地址空间，使其在上下文切换后仍可保留。

cards.definition: Page table split into pages tracked by a page directory, so unused regions cost nothing.
cards.example: Two-level x86 tables skip unmapped 4 MB ranges.

zh-Hans.definition: 将页表分页并由页目录跟踪，未使用区域不占空间。

cards.definition: One table for the whole machine indexed by physical frame, searched (often via hash) for a VPN.
cards.example: Saves space on large address spaces.

zh-Hans.definition: 全机一张按物理帧索引的表，通过（常为哈希）查找虚拟页号。

cards.definition: Disk area where pages are kept when they are not in physical memory.
cards.example: Idle tabs get swapped out to disk.

zh-Hans.definition: 页面不在物理内存时存放的磁盘区域。

cards.definition: PTE flag saying whether the page is in RAM or on disk.
cards.example: Present = 0 → page fault on access.

zh-Hans.definition: 表示页面在内存还是磁盘上的页表项标志。

cards.definition: Access to a page not in memory; the OS loads it from swap and retries.
cards.example: Touching a swapped-out page stalls for disk I/O.

zh-Hans.definition: 访问不在内存中的页；操作系统从交换区载入后重试。

cards.definition: Rule choosing which page to evict when memory is full (FIFO, LRU, clock…).
cards.example: Evict the page not used for the longest time.

zh-Hans.definition: 内存满时选择淘汰哪一页的规则（FIFO、LRU、时钟等）。

cards.definition: Least Recently Used: evict the page unused for the longest time; exploits temporal locality.
cards.example: Pages A, B, C used; C most recent → evict A.

zh-Hans.definition: 淘汰最长时间未使用的页；利用时间局部性。

cards.definition: Approximate LRU: sweep a hand over pages, clearing use bits until one with use = 0 is found.
cards.example: Cheaper than exact LRU on real hardware.

zh-Hans.definition: 近似 LRU：指针扫过各页并清除使用位，直到找到使用位为 0 的页。

cards.definition: Working sets exceed memory, so the system spends its time paging instead of computing.
cards.example: Too many processes → constant disk activity.

zh-Hans.definition: 工作集超过内存，系统大部分时间在换页而非计算。

cards.definition: Share pages read-only after fork() and copy a page only when someone writes it.
cards.example: fork() of a 1 GB process is still fast.

zh-Hans.definition: fork() 后以只读方式共享页面，仅在写入时才复制。

cards.definition: Allocate a zero-filled page only when it is first touched.
cards.example: A large heap allocation costs nothing until used.

zh-Hans.definition: 页面首次被访问时才分配并清零。

cards.definition: Instruction execution split into stages (fetch, decode, execute, memory, write-back) that overlap.
cards.example: Five instructions in flight at once.

zh-Hans.definition: 将指令执行分为取指、译码、执行、访存、写回等重叠进行的阶段。

cards.definition: Condition that stops the next instruction from proceeding: data, control or structural.
cards.example: An add needs a value still being loaded → stall.

zh-Hans.definition: 阻止下一条指令继续的情况：数据、控制或结构冒险。

cards.definition: Guessing a branch’s outcome to keep the pipeline full; a mispredict flushes work.
cards.example: Loop branches are predicted “taken”.

zh-Hans.definition: 猜测分支结果以保持流水线满载；预测失败则清空已做工作。

cards.definition: Layers of small fast caches (L1, L2, L3) between CPU and DRAM.
cards.example: L1 hit ~1 ns, DRAM ~100 ns.

zh-Hans.definition: CPU 与内存之间由小而快的多级缓存（L1、L2、L3）组成的层次。

cards.definition: Temporal: reused soon; spatial: neighbours used soon. Caches and TLBs rely on it.
cards.example: Looping over an array has both.

zh-Hans.definition: 时间局部性：近期再次使用；空间局部性：邻近数据随后被使用。缓存和 TLB 依赖于此。

cards.definition: Fixed-size block (often 64 B) moved between memory and cache as one unit.
cards.example: Reading one int pulls in 15 neighbours.

zh-Hans.definition: 在内存与缓存之间整体传输的固定大小块（常为 64 字节）。

cards.definition: Independent flow of execution sharing its process’s address space, with its own stack and registers.
cards.example: A web server handles each request on a thread.

zh-Hans.definition: 共享所属进程地址空间、拥有独立栈和寄存器的执行流。

cards.definition: Result depends on the timing of interleaved threads.
cards.example: Two threads increment a counter and one update is lost.

zh-Hans.definition: 结果取决于线程交错执行的时序。

cards.definition: Code that touches shared data and must not run in more than one thread at once.
cards.example: counter = counter + 1.

zh-Hans.definition: 访问共享数据、同一时间只能由一个线程执行的代码。

cards.definition: Guarantee that only one thread is in a critical section at a time.
cards.example: A lock provides mutual exclusion.

zh-Hans.definition: 保证同一时间只有一个线程处于临界区。

cards.definition: An operation happens entirely or not at all, with no visible intermediate state.
cards.example: Atomic increment cannot be interrupted halfway.

zh-Hans.definition: 操作要么完全发生要么完全不发生，不暴露中间状态。

cards.definition: Variable that one thread acquires before a critical section and releases after.
cards.example: pthread_mutex_lock(&m); … unlock(&m);

zh-Hans.definition: 线程进入临界区前获取、离开后释放的变量。

cards.definition: Lock that busy-waits in a loop until it becomes free.
cards.example: Fine on multicore for very short sections.

zh-Hans.definition: 在循环中忙等直到锁可用的锁。

cards.definition: Atomic instruction that returns the old value and sets a new one; basis of simple spin locks.
cards.example: while (TestAndSet(&flag, 1) == 1) ;

zh-Hans.definition: 原子地返回旧值并写入新值的指令；简单自旋锁的基础。

cards.definition: Atomically update a value only if it still equals an expected value.
cards.example: Lock-free counters loop on CAS.

zh-Hans.definition: 仅当值仍等于预期值时才原子地更新它。

cards.definition: Queue a thread can wait on until another thread signals that a condition changed.
cards.example: Consumer waits until the buffer is non-empty.

zh-Hans.definition: 线程可在其上等待、直到另一线程发出条件变化信号的队列。

cards.definition: Fixed-size shared queue: producers wait when full, consumers wait when empty.
cards.example: A pipeline of grep | wc.

zh-Hans.term: 有界缓冲区（生产者/消费者）
zh-Hans.definition: 固定大小的共享队列：满时生产者等待，空时消费者等待。

cards.definition: Integer with atomic wait (decrement, block if negative) and post (increment, wake one).
cards.example: Initialise to 1 for a lock, 0 for ordering.

zh-Hans.definition: 带原子 wait（减一，负数则阻塞）和 post（加一并唤醒）的整数。

cards.definition: Many readers may hold it together; a writer needs it alone.
cards.example: A cache read by many threads, rarely updated.

zh-Hans.definition: 多个读者可同时持有；写者须独占。

cards.definition: Threads each hold a resource and wait for another’s, so none can proceed.
cards.example: T1 holds A waits for B; T2 holds B waits for A.

zh-Hans.definition: 各线程持有资源并等待其他线程的资源，导致都无法继续。

cards.definition: Mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption and circular wait must all hold.
cards.example: Fix one: always acquire locks in a global order.

zh-Hans.definition: 互斥、持有并等待、不可抢占、循环等待必须同时成立。

cards.definition: Code assumed to run as a unit is interrupted between check and use.
cards.example: if (p) { use(p); } while another thread sets p = NULL.

zh-Hans.definition: 本应作为整体执行的代码在检查与使用之间被打断。

cards.definition: Two operations are expected in an order the code does not enforce.
cards.example: A thread uses an object before another initialises it.

zh-Hans.definition: 代码未保证两个操作按预期顺序执行。

cards.definition: One thread loops over events (via select/poll) and runs a handler for each; no locks needed.
cards.example: Node.js servers run an event loop.

zh-Hans.definition: 单线程循环等待事件（通过 select/poll）并逐个运行处理程序；无需锁。

cards.definition: Issue an I/O request and continue; get notified when it completes.
cards.example: aio_read() returns immediately.

zh-Hans.definition: 发出 I/O 请求后继续执行，完成时再获通知。

cards.definition: Concurrent lists, queues, hash tables protected by locks; finer locks raise parallelism.
cards.example: Per-bucket locks in a hash table.

zh-Hans.definition: 用锁保护的并发链表、队列、哈希表；细粒度锁可提高并行度。

cards.definition: Device signals the CPU when work is done, letting the OS run other tasks meanwhile.
cards.example: The disk raises an interrupt when a read completes.

zh-Hans.definition: 设备完成工作时通知 CPU，使操作系统在此期间可运行其他任务。

cards.definition: OS repeatedly checks a device status register instead of waiting for an interrupt.
cards.example: Fast devices are polled to avoid interrupt overhead.

zh-Hans.definition: 操作系统反复检查设备状态寄存器，而非等待中断。

cards.definition: Direct memory access: a controller copies data between device and memory without the CPU.
cards.example: A network card DMAs packets into RAM.

zh-Hans.definition: 由控制器在设备与内存间直接复制数据，无需 CPU 参与。

cards.definition: OS code that knows the details of one device and exposes a generic interface.
cards.example: Most of a kernel’s code is drivers.

zh-Hans.definition: 了解特定设备细节并提供通用接口的操作系统代码。

cards.definition: Time for a disk arm to move to the right track.
cards.example: Average seek ~4–10 ms.

zh-Hans.definition: 磁头臂移动到目标磁道所需的时间。

cards.definition: Time waiting for the right sector to rotate under the head.
cards.example: 7,200 RPM → ~4 ms average.

zh-Hans.definition: 等待目标扇区旋转到磁头下方的时间。

cards.definition: Time to read or write the data once the head is in place.
cards.example: Large sequential reads are transfer-dominated.

zh-Hans.definition: 磁头就位后读写数据所需的时间。

cards.definition: Ordering pending requests to cut seek and rotation (SSTF, SCAN/elevator, SPTF).
cards.example: The elevator algorithm sweeps the arm across tracks.

zh-Hans.definition: 对待处理请求排序以减少寻道和旋转（SSTF、SCAN/电梯、SPTF）。

cards.definition: Redundant array of inexpensive disks: many disks presented as one for speed and/or reliability.
cards.example: RAID-5 survives one disk failure.

zh-Hans.definition: 将多块廉价磁盘组合为一个逻辑盘以提升速度和/或可靠性。

cards.definition: Spread blocks across disks round-robin; fast, no redundancy.
cards.example: 4 disks → ~4× throughput, any failure loses data.

zh-Hans.definition: 将数据块轮流分布到多块磁盘；速度快但无冗余。

cards.definition: Keep a full copy of each block on two disks.
cards.example: Half the capacity, survives one failure per pair.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个数据块在两块磁盘上各存一份完整副本。

cards.definition: XOR of data blocks stored so one lost disk can be rebuilt; RAID-5 rotates parity.
cards.example: Lose one disk, recompute it from the others.

zh-Hans.definition: 存储数据块的异或值，可重建一块丢失的磁盘；RAID-5 轮换校验位置。

cards.definition: Linear array of bytes with a low-level name (inode number).
cards.example: /home/a/notes.txt is inode 1234.

zh-Hans.definition: 具有底层名称（inode 号）的线性字节数组。

cards.definition: File that maps human-readable names to inode numbers.
cards.example: The root directory “/” holds entries like home → 2.

zh-Hans.definition: 将可读名称映射到 inode 号的文件。

cards.definition: On-disk structure holding a file’s metadata and pointers to its data blocks.
cards.example: Size, owner, timestamps, block pointers.

zh-Hans.definition: 保存文件元数据及数据块指针的磁盘结构。

cards.definition: Per-process integer handle returned by open() for later read/write.
cards.example: fd 3 after stdin, stdout, stderr.

zh-Hans.definition: open() 返回、供后续读写使用的进程级整数句柄。

cards.definition: Another directory entry pointing to the same inode; file lives until all links are removed.
cards.example: ln a b — both names, one file.

zh-Hans.definition: 指向同一 inode 的另一个目录项；所有链接删除后文件才消失。

cards.definition: Small file containing a path to another file; can dangle.
cards.example: ln -s /data/latest current.

zh-Hans.definition: 包含另一文件路径的小文件；目标删除后会悬空。

cards.definition: Forces a file’s dirty data and metadata to persistent storage.
cards.example: Databases fsync before acknowledging a commit.

zh-Hans.definition: 强制将文件的脏数据和元数据写入持久存储。

cards.definition: Attach a file system at a directory so its tree becomes part of the namespace.
cards.example: mount /dev/sdb1 /mnt/data.

zh-Hans.definition: 将文件系统附加到某目录，使其目录树成为命名空间的一部分。

cards.definition: On-disk record describing the whole file system: sizes, counts, where structures live.
cards.example: Read first at mount time.

zh-Hans.definition: 描述整个文件系统（大小、数量、结构位置）的磁盘记录。

cards.definition: One bit per inode or data block marking free or used.
cards.example: Data bitmap bit 57 = 1 → block 57 in use.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个 inode 或数据块对应一位，标记空闲或已用。

cards.definition: Disk-aware file system that groups related files and inodes in cylinder groups to cut seeks.
cards.example: Files in one directory land in the same group.

zh-Hans.definition: 感知磁盘结构的文件系统，用柱面组把相关文件和 inode 放在一起以减少寻道。

cards.definition: Keeping on-disk structures consistent if power fails mid-update.
cards.example: An inode updated but its bitmap not.

zh-Hans.definition: 在更新中途断电时保持磁盘结构一致。

cards.definition: File system checker that scans everything after a crash to repair inconsistencies; slow on big disks.
cards.example: Hours of fsck on a multi-TB volume.

zh-Hans.definition: 崩溃后扫描全部结构以修复不一致的工具；大磁盘上很慢。

cards.definition: Write intended updates to a log first, commit, then apply; replay the log after a crash.
cards.example: ext4 journals metadata before checkpointing it.

zh-Hans.definition: 先将更新写入日志并提交，再应用到原位置；崩溃后重放日志。

cards.definition: Journal only metadata; write data blocks first so metadata never points at garbage.
cards.example: Ordered mode in ext3/ext4.

zh-Hans.definition: 仅记录元数据日志；先写数据块，确保元数据不指向垃圾。

cards.definition: Buffers all writes and writes them sequentially to new disk segments; needs cleaning.
cards.example: Turns random small writes into large sequential ones.

zh-Hans.definition: 缓冲所有写入并顺序写到新的磁盘段；需要清理。

cards.definition: LFS structure locating the latest version of each inode, since inodes move on every write.
cards.example: The checkpoint region points to the imap.

zh-Hans.definition: LFS 中定位每个 inode 最新版本的结构，因为 inode 每次写入都会移动。

cards.definition: Copying live blocks out of old segments so they can be reused.
cards.example: The LFS cleaner compacts half-empty segments.

zh-Hans.definition: 将旧段中的存活块复制出来，使其可被重新使用。

cards.definition: Storage built from NAND flash: no moving parts, but must erase whole blocks before rewriting pages.
cards.example: Random reads in tens of microseconds.

zh-Hans.definition: 由 NAND 闪存构成的存储：无机械部件，但重写页面前须擦除整个块。

cards.definition: SSD firmware mapping logical blocks to physical pages, log-style.
cards.example: The FTL redirects each write to a fresh page.

zh-Hans.definition: 以日志方式将逻辑块映射到物理页的 SSD 固件。

cards.definition: Spreading erases across all flash blocks so none wears out early.
cards.example: Cold data is moved to let its block be used.

zh-Hans.definition: 将擦除分散到所有闪存块，避免个别块过早磨损。

cards.definition: Total flash writes divided by writes requested by the host.
cards.example: Garbage collection makes 1 GB written cost 3 GB.

zh-Hans.definition: 闪存实际写入总量与主机请求写入量之比。

cards.definition: Small digest stored with data to detect corruption on read.
cards.example: Mismatch → read the mirror copy instead.

zh-Hans.definition: 与数据一同存储、读取时用于检测损坏的小摘要。

cards.definition: A sector that cannot be read, discovered only when accessed.
cards.example: Disk returns an error; RAID rebuilds from redundancy.

zh-Hans.definition: 直到被访问才发现的无法读取的扇区。

cards.definition: Periodically reading all blocks to find corruption before it is needed.
cards.example: Weekly scrub of a storage array.

zh-Hans.definition: 定期读取所有块，在需要之前发现损坏。

cards.definition: Many machines cooperating over a network, built to keep working despite failures.
cards.example: A web service running on hundreds of servers.

zh-Hans.definition: 通过网络协作、在故障下仍能工作的多台机器。

cards.definition: Calling a function on another machine as if it were local; stubs marshal arguments.
cards.example: Client calls read(); the stub sends a message to the server.

zh-Hans.definition: 像调用本地函数一样调用远程机器上的函数；存根负责参数编组。

cards.definition: Resend a request if no acknowledgment arrives in time; needs duplicate handling.
cards.example: No ACK in 100 ms → resend.

zh-Hans.definition: 在规定时间内未收到确认则重发请求；需处理重复。

cards.definition: Performing it twice has the same effect as once, so retries are safe.
cards.example: Write block 5 at offset 0 is idempotent; append is not.

zh-Hans.definition: 执行两次与一次效果相同，因此重试是安全的。

cards.definition: Sun’s Network File System: a stateless protocol for sharing files over the network.
cards.example: Home directories mounted from a file server.

zh-Hans.definition: Sun 的网络文件系统：通过网络共享文件的无状态协议。

cards.definition: Server keeps no per-client state; each request carries everything needed, easing crash recovery.
cards.example: NFS reads include file handle, offset and count.

zh-Hans.definition: 服务器不保存客户端状态；每个请求自带全部信息，便于崩溃恢复。

cards.definition: NFS identifier for a file: volume, inode number and generation.
cards.example: Every NFS request names a file handle.

zh-Hans.definition: NFS 中标识文件的值：卷、inode 号与世代号。

cards.definition: Keeping client caches from serving stale data after another client writes.
cards.example: NFS flushes on close and checks attributes before using cache.

zh-Hans.definition: 防止其他客户端写入后本地缓存提供过期数据。

cards.definition: Andrew File System: whole-file caching with server callbacks, built to scale to many clients.
cards.example: Open fetches the whole file; close writes it back.

zh-Hans.definition: 采用整文件缓存和服务器回调、可扩展到大量客户端的文件系统。

cards.definition: Server promise to notify a client when its cached file changes, so clients need not poll.
cards.example: Server breaks the callback when another client writes.

zh-Hans.definition: 服务器承诺在缓存文件变化时通知客户端，使客户端无需轮询。
